meta.designRule: Keep LDoE relationships, not exact LDoE values. External LDoE observations are not approved facts for our game. This approval covers study structure and research direction only, not final yields or balance.

provisional.economyIntent: Floor1 slightly profitable, Floor2 break-even, Floor3 net-loss without overworld prep — INTENT ONLY, not proven

1_overworldZoneInventory.purpose: List all overworld sources that can drop resources — all drops are hypotheses until verified

requirements: First visit must be completable unarmed.
Mandatory combat is not allowed during the first visit.
Initial resources must be hand-gatherable or world-lootable.
Target no-combat visit should remain under 10 minutes.
First run must provide measurable progress toward first base repair at the workbench/storage foundation.
Food and water availability in Pine Grove must be evaluated before finalizing the no-starting-food/no-starting-water rule.
Travel time and survival drain must be measured together to validate that the provisional 80%/80% start does not soft-lock.
softTensions: The provisional 80%/80% start supports one short loop but may not support two consecutive loops without food or water.
The no-weapon start requires Pine Grove gathering to avoid mandatory combat and weapon-gated resources.

firstVisitStudyDefinition.purpose: Define the measurements required to validate the first overworld loop without inventing yields, travel times, objective costs, or emergency supplies.
routeMeasurements: Measure base exit to Pine Grove zone-load completion on foot without a sprint bonus.
Measure a route covering all first-visit hand-gatherable nodes and world-loot spawns without backtracking beyond zone bounds.
Measure Pine Grove exit to base entry, including overworld map traversal if applicable.
Record the complete exit + gather + return loop duration as the survival-drain basis.
Target no-combat gathering duration is under 10 minutes; this is a requirement, not a measured result.
resourceMeasurements: Record scrap obtained during the first visit from world loot and gatherable nodes.
Measure repeatable scrap rate over a 30-minute loop using 2–3 timed runs.
Record whether food is present and its type and amount as observations, not final balance.
Record whether water is present and its observed amount, without finalizing a yield.
Record whether cloth is present and keep it separate from food, water, scrap, and oil.
Verify whether oil is absent or present; absence is an expectation to test, not a final value.
Record whether any node requires a tool. Any required tool must be found in the same zone and cannot be craft-gated for the first visit.
safetyMeasurements: Preserve the requirement that the first visit is unarmed and has no mandatory combat.
Record threat types, movement speed, vision behavior, patrol or static behavior, and node-blocking frequency.
Record whether threats can be outrun or avoided and any stamina cost.
Record available avoidance routes, cover, and zone-edge escape options.
survivalMeasurements: Calculate hunger loss as provisional hunger drain multiplied by measured total loop minutes.
Calculate thirst loss as provisional thirst drain multiplied by measured total loop minutes.
Evaluate remaining hunger and thirst from the provisional 80%/80% start after one complete loop.
Evaluate whether a second loop reaches zero before return; this informs, but does not decide, the emergency-cache question.
Use the current drain rates as provisional study inputs, not final balance values.
firstObjectiveMeasurements: Define the required scrap for the broken workbench/storage foundation as a missing design input; do not invent it in this study.
Determine whether one or two first visits are expected after the required scrap value is approved.
Treat three or more required runs as a potential opening-grind risk requiring review, not as an automatic balance rule.

verifiedFindings: The opening sequence is defined and committed.
The provisional 80%/80% state provides approximately 36 minutes of hunger and 28 minutes of thirst before reaching zero under the current provisional drain rates.
Backpack capacity 8 and loot reserve 3 remain provisional.
The camera foundation supports visibility of the player and gathering objectives.
Resources remain separate and there is no badge-to-resource conversion.
hypotheses: Pine Grove can provide first-repair progress in one or two unarmed runs.
The player can avoid threats on the first visit through pathing.
Thirst may be the limiting need for a second trip.
missingMeasurements: Total hunger and thirst loss per loop.
Approved scrap requirement for the first objective.
provisionalAssumptions: Hunger drain 2.222222 per minute and thirst drain 2.857143 per minute.
Fort clear times 12/15/18 minutes; not used as Pine Grove results.

combat.measure: time to clear zone with enemies

noCombat.measure: time to clear zone after enemies cleared

3_averageYieldPer30Min.method: Run 30min farming loop, 3 repetitions per zone type

5_resourceSeparationRule.rule: Keep food, water, scrap, cloth, oil, detection as separate resources. Do not convert badges to resources.

foodNeeded.reason: Requires authoritative total fort duration and survival-drain multiplier

waterNeeded.reason: Requires authoritative total fort duration and survival-drain multiplier
